title.zh: 将黎刹省Malabon市镇的San Marcelo小村改设为该市镇名为Acacia村的村，并使其与该市镇Tugatog村分离的法案
title.en: An Act to Convert the Sitio of San Marcelo, Municipality of Malabon, Province of Rizal, into a Barrio to be Known as Barrio Acacia of the Same Municipality and Separating it from the Barrio of Tugatog of the Same Municipality
title.orig: An Act to Convert the Sitio of San Marcelo, Municipality of Malabon, Province of Rizal, into a Barrio to be Known as Barrio Acacia of the Same Municipality and Separating it from the Barrio of Tugatog of the Same Municipality

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1498_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of San Marcelo in the Municipality of Malabon, Province of Rizal, is hereby separated from the barrio of Tugatog and converted into a distinct barrio to be known as barrio Acacia of the same municipality.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1956.
